entries.title: hold HttpArena's connections-1m fleet in bench/httparena (WP71 S2g)
entries.body:
The HttpArena entry now subscribes to connections-1m and is sized to hold its million keep-alive connections on 8080. It listens on 0.0.0.0, sets no connection cap below the fleet, and closes no idle connection before nish/net/http-server's 60 s idle timeout.

With slots 0, which the CMD now passes, arenaSlots gives each worker's HTTP/1.1 listener 4 times its even share of 1,000,000, at least 16,384 and at most 1,048,576: 62,500 a worker on HttpArena's 64-CPU server cpuset. The headroom absorbs prefork's uneven CPU steering under HttpArena's cpusets. The h2c listener keeps 16,384 slots, because its stream tables are allocated up front. A slots value above 0 keeps its old meaning.

Memory per held connection is measured in bench/httparena/README.md: 235-237 bytes at 78,000 held on 4 workers (band 2 bytes), RSS only. A million was not held, and the figure is not extrapolated to one.

tests/link/httparena_entry grows from 46 to 64 checks: serving on 0.0.0.0, /baseline11 on 127.0.0.2, .32 and .160, 200 connections held idle for 6 s and answered again, arenaSlots's edges, and the slots the CMD's slots 0 gave each listener.

Tests: tests/link/httparena_entry
Fixes #2313
Part of #2323
Verified: pr-adversary 1 round, CI green
entries.author: Amrit Kahlon

entries.title: reuse the Release PR's green run for the release, and scope and split slow jobs
entries.body:
A release no longer runs the whole of ci.yml a second time at the tag:
release.yml's new `verdict` job (scripts/ci-verdict.mjs) finds the green
ci.yml run the Release PR dispatched on the tag's tree, and `ci` runs only
when there is none or anything errors. `binaries` now builds beside `ci`.

The gfx jobs are scoped to the changes that reach them. The QUIC interop
runner is split into parallel rows per client, and its crosstraffic
measurement runs only on a release's tag, so a PR's or main's interop run
ends about 10 minutes in instead of about 22. The interop build skips the
Release PR's merge push, and the shard cost table is refitted from main's
runs.

entries.title: prove a checked string NUL-free at an ffi call
entries.body:
The bounds prover now proves that a string argument at a foreign call is NUL-free when the code turned a NUL away first: `if (s.indexOf("\u0000") >= 0) return`, or its `< 0` mirror, on a local that is not reassigned before the call. The emitter then drops the `memchr` check and its `ffi-nul` panic. The proof is read only for a bare local, never for an element access or a `pop()` the prover proved in range.

`nish/sync/shm`'s `createRegion`, `openRegion` and `unlinkRegion` now check for a NUL first, which clears their three `ffi-nul` sites. `examples/prefork-jobs.ts` builds without `--allow-panics`.

Fixes #2298

entries.title: set visited links further from the link colour and link the Roadmap issue from the README
entries.body:
The docs site's visited link was halfway between the link violet and the
secondary text grey, which in dark mode (#b69adb beside #b47cf0) could not be

entries.title: WP39 G7 — take an h2c peer by its preface on an opted-in HTTP/1.1 listener
entries.body:
HttpServer.listenHttp1 takes an optional fourth argument, h2c: Http2Config | null. With it set, the listener reads each new connection's first bytes against the 24-byte HTTP/2 connection preface: the first differing byte or an early close hands the connection to Http1Server with the bytes already read as its input; all 24 matching hands the socket to Http2CleartextServer with the preface already fed; a partial preface followed by silence is closed after prefaceTimeout. A PRI * HTTP/1.1 request matches for 11 bytes and is served as HTTP/1.1. There is no Upgrade: h2c. Without the argument nothing is read ahead and behaviour is unchanged.

Carriers gain Http1Server.release(slot) and Http2CleartextServer.adopt(fd, preface). Security records: HTTPSRV-24 (Holds), HTTPSRV-25 (Low, open, untested), with adopt and release rows in the h2c and http1-codec records.

Tests: tests/link/net_http_server_h2c_preface and ten sibling cases
Fixes #2012
